description: This file defines the I18NHelper class in the OrangeHRM project, providing functions for internationalization support such as translation and language setting, utilizing an I18N service.

classes.name: I18NHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing translation functionalities and language settings for internationalization.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18N service instance from the container.

methods.name: trans
methods.description: Translates a given key into the current language, returning the key itself if I18N is disabled.

methods.name: transBySource
methods.description: Translates a source language string into the current language, returning the source string if I18N is disabled.

methods.name: setTranslatorLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for the I18N translator service.
